details.direction: Four laps of a 10.55 km loop from Union Glacier camp; the loop direction is not published.
details.distanceMethod: Official home page: 26.2 miles. Official FAQ: the marathon is normally a 10.55 km loop repeated four times with an aid station every 5 km. Four laps arithmetically total 42.20 km, about 5 m short of 42.195 km; this page treats 42.195 km as the nominal marathon distance and preserves the loop arithmetic rather than inventing a measured 42.195 km loop. No GPX or surveyed course map is published.
details.attribution: Antarctic Ice Marathon / Runbuk. No GPX, GeoJSON or surveyed course map is published; the map anchor uses the ALE Union Glacier camp coordinates (79°46′S 82°52′W).
